This '''duel''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], when [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] were dispatched to Gala, to deal with the upcoming elections, and the mystery of the poisoning of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda]]. Obi-Wan discovered that it was the Queen's serving boy, [[Jono Dunn]] who was responsible, and was running through the palace's [[Royal reception room]] when he bumped right into the Queen's fiery son. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Beju]]. Playing on Beju's pride, Obi-Wan convinced him not to call the guards.

Beju pulled out a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] from a display case and challenged Obi-Wan to duel. He threw Obi-Wan a sword, but then attacked before he was fully ready, cutting threw Obi-Wan's tunic and drawing blood. The duel seemed to be in Beju's favor, until Obi-Wan opened himself to [[The Force/Legends|The Force]], and managed to disarm Beju. Beju went to retrieve his fallen weapon, only to be interrupted by [[Viso]], the blind [[Council Minister]]. Distracted, Obi-Wan scooped up the sword, ending the duel, and allowing the old man to talk some sense into the arrogant Prince.
